meta.title: Vendor e-mail when the submission time is extended
gaps: Open QA vendor mailboxes and verify that each concerned vendor receives exactly one new-end-time email, while no other vendor or real supplier receives it.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open QA vendor mailboxes and verify that each concerned vendor receives exactly one new-end-time email, while no other vendor or real supplier receives it.

steps.note: Start a multi-stage-capable event creation flow for the test event.
Provide the required event title so the event can be published.
Use a submission-based RFQ stage whose time can be extended.
Apply the first available RFQ template required before adding line items.
Add one product so the event has a valid pricing sheet.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet before publishing.
Commit a live submission window that can be extended.
Invite two QA vendors so recipient and non-recipient behavior can be checked externally.
Publish the event to make its submission window active.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Trigger the submission-time extension that should generate vendor notification emails.

args.need: open the QA mailboxes of both concerned vendors and verify that each receives exactly one email announcing the new submission end time, while no other vendor or real supplier receives it

steps.note: Mailbox access and cross-recipient email verification are outside the catalog.
Assert that the Procol session remained free of application errors after the extension and mailbox verification task.
